7498.title: Panel width inheritance invalidation
7498.rootCauseOneLine: The panel writes an unregistered custom property on its aside, so the value inherits into every descendant and each write invalidates their computed styles.

prReviews.verdict: Targets verified cause — static review only
prReviews.topFinding: No blocker in the inspected diff; PR code was not executed.

7498.proposedFix: Register the panel-only width property as non-inherited, leaving its unset state without a concrete initial value so the existing container-width fallback remains effective.
7498.caveats: Focused browser invalidation reproduction; full-app frame times unverified. No duplicate PR because #7499 is open. Reproduction scripts and measurements are inline in the report.
